description: This file defines a trait 'SparkOperation' providing utility methods and lifecycle management for Spark SQL operations within the Hive Thrift Server context, including session handling, error management, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: SparkOperation
classes.description: A trait providing utility functions for Spark SQL operations, including session management, error handling, and resource cleanup within the Hive Thrift Server environment.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Overrides the run method to execute with local properties set.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the operation, performs cleanup, and logs the closure.

methods.name: withLocalProperties
methods.description: Sets thread-local properties for the duration of a code block, including Spark session and scheduler pool, then restores original properties.

methods.name: tableTypeString
methods.description: Converts a CatalogTableType to its string representation.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during operation, logs error details, updates operation state, and throws appropriate exceptions.
